reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "add env annotation to render docker runtime container by @blacs30 in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/6372", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A new optional annotation for passing env to the render Docker runtime container; the evidence states no effect on existing setups.

proposed.statement: Crossplane 2.0.0 adds an annotation that sets environment variables on the Docker runtime container used by render; this is a new capability, and the release note says nothing breaks.
